documents.evidence: On marantec.com, served through its eba_download handler rather than as a static path. Document number 101258 and version D are the handler's own query parameters - Marantec versions its documents by letter, so the vrsn value is the edition and worth keeping. A parameterised URL is more fragile than a static one; the installation-instructions index is the route back in. Not fetched - egress blocked.
